# TMalign standalone program test cases (USalign-beta branch)
# run_test.py appends "-outdir ." to every case, so generated files stay in the
# case working directory and are collected as comparison artifacts.
# Format: <name> <working_dir> <arguments...>
# <working_dir> is relative to the data/ directory
#
# Covers: plain TM-align (default), -a average-length normalisation, -u/-d
# user-defined length and d0, -i (start from alignment) and -I (stick to
# alignment), -m rotation matrix output, superposition output (-o on master,
# renamed to -pymol on the beta branch), and a real protein pair.
# Generated artifacts compared: sup.pdb and matrix.txt (the .pml scripts are not
# compared: the beta branch additionally writes sup_structure2.pdb and reloads it
# from the .pml file).

tmalign_basic      help    model.pdb native.pdb -outfmt -1
tmalign_a          help    model.pdb native.pdb -a T -outfmt -1
tmalign_ud         help    model.pdb native.pdb -u 100 -d 5.0 -outfmt -1
tmalign_i          help    model.pdb native.pdb -i align.txt -outfmt -1
tmalign_I          help    model.pdb native.pdb -I align.txt -outfmt -1
tmalign_matrix     help    model.pdb native.pdb -m matrix.txt -outfmt -1
tmalign_real       help    ../101m.pdb ../1mba.pdb -outfmt -1
tmalign_superpose  help    model.pdb native.pdb -pymol sup -outfmt -1
